findings.desc: quality-cleanup: command-policy.ts:209 guard_session_check is classified ownershipClass=readOnly with reason "without mutating story metadata" but the handler calls store.writeGuardSession() on every invocation (writes guard-session.json in the story directory). The reason text is factually incorrect and contradicts process-fact-levels.ts which accurately states "records forbidden writes". This metadata inconsistency means the ownership enforcement gate treats guard_session_check as a read-only command while it is a story-scoped write, potentially misleading maintainers and allowing non-owner sessions to overwrite guard session state.
